newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar heads lower, tracks weak NY raws.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar heads lower, tracks weak NY raws.

text.p: White sugar futures drifted lower on Wednesday afternoon but the weakness was seen more as a reaction to sliding prices in New York than bearish sentiment in London, traders said.
The thin volume on the whites was boosted by against actuals trades from the earlier part of the session, which was followed by a sprinkling of crosses.
Market sources said the amount of genuine trading was probably nearer to 300 lots of the 820 posted on the board by 1455 GMT.
All traded positions lost ground, with October down $1.50 at $326.80 and December down $1.30 at $322.50.

Traders said London now needed a sentiment boost from New York as the fund buying interest in the whites appeared to have disappeared for the time being, although the spec long position had increased over the last week.
The Paris market was quiet although all the nearby contracts traded lost ground.
October was down $2.70 at $326.30 and December down $1.50 at $322.50. Matif volume totalled a light 97 lots.
